page.notes: Printed marginal notes and the in-text marks are transcribed above. Doubtful readings: the Greek words in brackets (illegible); "irã" in the first paragraph (marked [?] in the text); "Redigi" and "vil-li" in the right-margin note on Tolle iura, which is omitted here because it runs beside the text and I could not read it with confidence. The marginal note beginning "Tolle iura Imperatorum" and the notes on Supra, Greg., and Meum contain further uncertain readings that were not flagged inline. The running head keeps "Cap.6." as printed. The text ends on the hyphenated "acti-", and the catchword "uitatis" follows at the foot.
